title: Multi-style conversion for semantic segmentation of lesions in fundus images by adversarial attacks
mechanism: A linear probe on encoder features detects dataset origin. An adversarial input perturbation toward a chosen dataset makes the frozen model segment in that dataset's annotation style, with no retraining.
adaptation: Train a source probe on the frozen house encoder, then at test take a few PGD steps that push each cell toward its own source (or toward ARTS for thin output). Measure the change in crack width and IoU.
min_experiment: Arm = PGD style steering on the existing 5-seed ensemble versus the unmodified ensemble. Metric: crack IoU clean-49. Kill if < +0.005. Under 2 GPU-h.
evidence: R: diabetic retinopathy lesion datasets with different annotation protocols; continuous style conversion shown (numbers not retrieved).

alt_notes.adaptation: No retraining: probe source on frozen house encoder features, then at test push each image toward its own source (or toward ARTS for thin output) with a few PGD steps on the probe; measure crack width and IoU.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PGD style push on existing house checkpoints (5 seeds). Baseline: same checkpoints without push. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and per-source predicted width. Kill if IoU gain < +0.008 or widths do not move by >= 0.2 px.
